node.title: L1 m=4, h=3 Mason defect budget
node.statement: For a hypothetical exact h=3 pencil on an official row n=4(p+1), depress the outer cubic and write (R^3+aR+b)D=X^n-alpha with deg R=p and deg D=p+4. Its linear coefficient satisfies a!=0. If nu=ord_0(R), then 0<=nu<=4, and H=3XU'D+XUD'-(n-3nu)UD is nonzero of degree at most 4-nu for U=R/X^nu. The product of the radical-defect factors UD/rad(UD) and B_0/rad(B_0), where B_0=((aR+b)D+alpha)/X^(3nu), divides H. Hence every repeated-root or overlap defect is localized at at most 4-nu points and the total defect is at most 4-nu. This is a finite low-defect classification target, not an emptiness theorem, component count, nonembedded h=2 classification, or L1 bound.
